prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet lives right on your desktop screen, reacting to your daily activity and bringing life to your workflow."]
1: ["Creating your desktop pet takes less than 2 minutes."]
2: ["Sign in with your primary account to keep your pet save file synchronized safely."]
3: ["Save Your Companion Progress", "Log in to safely pair your pet traits and account data."]
4: ["Name Your New Friend", "Give your desktop pet a unique name and pick their personality.", "Pet Name", "Select Personality"]
5: ["Upload well-lit photos showing a clear face for accurate AI pet generation."]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Review your pet details and stamp the official adoption agreement.", "Verify Pet Identity", "Registered Desktop Pet"]
7: ["Preparing Your Pet Habitat", "We are setting up your pet on your desktop screen. We will notify you when it appears."]
8: ["Initializing Desktop Pet", "Configuring overlay permissions and loading pet graphics...", "Loading desktop components..."]
9: ["Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick controls, minimize, or feed it!"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos showing the user's face
